scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-harness/plugin-api && npm run build -w @pi-harness/core && npm run build:plugins && npm run build -w @pi-harness/plugin-hello && npm run build -w @pi-harness/cli && npm run build -w @pi-harness/host-webserver && npm run build -w @pi-harness/api-gateway && npm run build -w @pi-harness/client-web && npm run build -w @pi-harness/web-app && npm run build -w @pi-harness/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @pi-harness/plugin-api && npm run build -w @pi-harness/core && npm run build:plugins && npm run build -w @pi-harness/cli && npm run build -w @pi-harness/host-webserver && npm run build -w @pi-harness/api-gateway && npm run build -w @pi-harness/client-web && npm run build -w @pi-harness/web-app && npm run build -w @pi-harness/web
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && node -e "for (const target of ['packages/api-gateway/dist','packages/bundle-web-app/dist','packages/client-web/dist','packages/host-webserver/dist','apps/web/dist','apps/web/server-dist']) require('node:fs').rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run lint:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/plugin-api && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/core && node scripts/build-plugins.mjs --typecheck && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/plugin-hello && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/cli && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/host-webserver && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/api-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/client-web && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/web-app && npm run typecheck -w @pi-harness/web
